Sub: Delegation of financial/administrative powers in case of indoor 
medical treatment taken by the retired employees of EPFO and/or 
their spouse/dependents under CS (MA) Rules, 1944 - regarding. 
Sir, 
This is in regard to certain references received from various regions about 
regulation of cases of indoor medical treatment taken by the retired employees of 
EPFO and/or their spouse/dependents involving relaxation under CS(MA) 
rules, 1944.In certain Regions, court cases have also been filed by retired employees 
for medical reimbursement in case of indoor medical treatment taken by the them 
and/or their spouse/dependents from non-recognized hospitals in emergent 
circumstances. 
2. 	
In this regard, attention is invited to HO circular no. HRIV1-V/12(2)2004/48740 
dated 1.10.2009(copy enclosed) vide which it was clarified that delegation of 
financial/administrative powers, in the case of indoor treatment taken by the retired 
employees of EPFO and/or their spouse/dependents, are meant for cases involving 
relaxation under CS (MA) Rules, 1944.Therefore, it is requested to regulate all such 
cases accordingly to avoid inconvenience to the retired employees. 
Yours faithfully, 
(Sanjay Bish ) 
Regional P.F. Commissioner-I (HRM)
